explication: Biscotti is a local-first macOS meeting recorder: users capture a meeting, receive a speaker-labeled transcript, and can get AI-generated summaries and action items. The graph preserves the README’s documented calendar, auto-stop, notes, vocabulary, MCP, and speaker-identification capabilities. Edges are limited to README statements and relationships shown by the supplied source index or excerpts; unsampled implementation links are omitted or marked dashed.
